caption: The drawing features a single wooden object centrally placed on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a rounded knob at the top, from which a smoothly tapered cylindrical shaft descends to a wide, bulbous base. The wood grain pattern is visible throughout the object, displaying natural variations in shades of brown, with subtle darker rings and markings accentuating the surface. The base of the object is noticeably wider and more rounded than the rest of the form, and contains some visible surface imperfections or textural details. There is a faint shadow around the base, indicating a light source from above. The artist's signature, "Susan Clever," is visible in small, light script near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Masher
